create_pegasus_config: create a PegasusConfig instance with default model settings for google/pegasus-large
init_pegasus_model_with_config: initialize a PegasusModel with a PegasusConfig to build a transformer model with random weights
access_model_config: access the configuration object from a trained PegasusModel via the config attribute
customize_pegasus_encoder_layers: customize PegasusConfig encoder layers, attention heads, and feed-forward dimensions for a custom model
set_pegasus_token_ids: set PegasusConfig decoder_start_token_id, pad_token_id, and eos_token_id for token-aware inference
